purpose: This form is used by a resigning director to forward a copy of their resignation along with reasons to the Registrar.
who: A director who resigns from his office
when: Within a period of thirty days from the date of resignation
steps: Prepare Form DIR-11 with your resignation and reasons.
Include the required fee as provided in the Companies Rules.
Forward the form to the Registrar within thirty days from the date of resignation.
checklist: Fee as provided in the Companies Rules
Written authorization if a foreign director is appointing a representative to sign and file
watch: Foreign directors may authorize a professional or resident director in writing to file if Form DIR-12 was already filed.
